\sphinxstylestrong{Initial Release}

\sphinxAtStartPar
First mandate document for the StarSync Network project. Defines requirements
for automated star\sphinxhyphen{}network repository synchronization across three machines
with GitHub as central hub. Includes the standing order for standardised
task documentation workflow for all future agent tasks.
\end{quote}

\sphinxstepscope


\section{Purpose}
\label{\detokenize{purpose:purpose}}\label{\detokenize{purpose::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This document formally states the requirements, objectives, and constraints
for the StarSync Network project. It represents the authoritative statement
of what the client (DATRO Consortium) wants to achieve, why the project is
needed, and the conditions under which the work will be accepted.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The mandate serves as the foundation upon which the Brief (detailed
approach) and Plan (execution strategy) are built.


\section{Standardised Task Documentation Protocol}
\label{\detokenize{purpose:standardised-task-documentation-protocol}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
ALL future tasks assigned to any Hermes agent on the three machines
(laptop, aws\sphinxhyphen{}command, aws\sphinxhyphen{}ai) MUST follow this documentation protocol:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Mandate} \sphinxhyphen{} What the client wants and why. The authoritative client
requirement. This document must exist and be approved before any work
commences.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Brief} \sphinxhyphen{} The proposed solution approach. How the agent intends to
satisfy the mandate requirements. Includes architecture, technical
decisions, and work packages.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Plan} \sphinxhyphen{} The detailed execution strategy with phases, tasks,
timelines, resource assignments, and success criteria.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{PR Preview} \sphinxhyphen{} After writing the Mandate, Brief, and Plan documents,
the agent commits them to a branch and creates a pull request. A preview
URL (via Cloudflare Pages serving \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{datro/static/library}}) is generated
and sent to the person or agent who gave the instruction.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Client Review} \sphinxhyphen{} The client reviews the rendered documents at the
preview URL or PR. Changes may be requested.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Semantic Versioning} \sphinxhyphen{} When changes are requested:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clone the current \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{latest}} directory to its semver number
(e.g., 0.0.0, 0.0.1) as a backup

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Update \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{latest}} to the next semantic version

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Apply the requested changes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Note: changes cascade downward \textendash{} a mandate change requires brief and
plan updates; a brief change requires plan updates; plan changes
are usually isolated

\end{itemize}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Approval} \sphinxhyphen{} Once the client confirms the documents, execution proceeds
according to the Plan.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Highlight Report} \sphinxhyphen{} After execution, a Highlight Report documents
actual outcomes versus the Plan, including any deviations, issues logged,
and lessons learned.

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This standing order applies to ALL tasks, not just this project. The
documents must be placed in:
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{datro/static/library/consortium\_projects/\{mandate,brief,plan,highlight\}\_\textless{}project\textgreater{}/}}

\sphinxstepscope


\section{Background}
\label{\detokenize{background:background}}\label{\detokenize{background::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The DATRO Consortium operates multiple development endpoints that each maintain local clones of Git repositories. Changes made independently on any endpoint need to propagate through a central GitHub repository to all other endpoints. This creates a star network topology where GitHub is the central hub and each machine is a spoke.


\subsection{Current State}
\label{\detokenize{background:current-state}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The situation before this project:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No Automated Sync} \textendash{} Each machine requires manual \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{git add}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{commit}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{push}}, and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{pull}} operations. Changes made on one machine do not automatically appear on others.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No PR Automation} \textendash{} Local changes are not automatically proposed as pull requests with preview links for client review.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No Remote Monitoring} \textendash{} No system detects when GitHub is updated or automatically pulls new changes to local endpoints.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{static/ui Blocked} \textendash{} The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{static/ui}} folder on the Command AWS (13.135.142.244) has 432 files that have not been pushed to GitHub, preventing sync to the laptop.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Excessive Local Changes} \textendash{} The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{datro}} repository on the laptop has 28,398 uncommitted changes; on the Command AWS it has 34,886. These cannot be safely auto\sphinxhyphen{}committed.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No Standardised Documentation} \textendash{} Tasks given to agents were not documented in the Datro Consortium Mandate/Brief/Plan format with PR preview links and semantic versioning.

\end{enumerate}


\subsection{Endpoint Inventory}
\label{\detokenize{background:endpoint-inventory}}
\sphinxstepscope


\section{Objectives}
\label{\detokenize{objectives:objectives}}\label{\detokenize{objectives::doc}}

\subsection{Primary Objectives}
\label{\detokenize{objectives:primary-objectives}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Automated Change Detection} \textendash{} Each endpoint runs a cron job every 5 minutes to check tracked repositories for uncommitted changes.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Auto\sphinxhyphen{}Commit and Push} \textendash{} Repositories with 500 or fewer changed files are automatically committed and pushed to a branch named \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{autosync/\{hostname\}/\{timestamp\}}} on GitHub.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Automatic PR Creation} \textendash{} Pushing to an autosync branch triggers creation of a pull request targeting the default branch (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gh\sphinxhyphen{}pages}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{main}}).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Telegram Delivery} \textendash{} The PR URL is sent to the client’s Telegram chat for review and approval before merging.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Remote Change Pulling} \textendash{} Each endpoint monitors its tracked branch on GitHub for new commits and pulls them automatically via \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{git fetch}} and \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{git pull \sphinxhyphen{}\sphinxhyphen{}rebase}}.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Agent Fallback} \textendash{} When sync fails (merge conflicts, push rejection, network errors), a Hermes agent is spawned in YOLO mode to diagnose and resolve the issue without human intervention.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{static/ui Propagation} \textendash{} Push the 432\sphinxhyphen{}file \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{static/ui}} folder from aws\sphinxhyphen{}command to GitHub, creating a PR for client review.

\end{enumerate}


\subsection{Secondary Objectives}
\label{\detokenize{objectives:secondary-objectives}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\setcounter{enumi}{7}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Documentation Protocol} \textendash{} Establish the Mandate/Brief/Plan workflow as the standing order for all future agent tasks across all three machines.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Semantic Versioning} \textendash{} All project documents follow semantic versioning with proper backup of superseded versions.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Library Standards} \textendash{} Follow established Datro Consortium documentation formatting, build with Sphinx, produce HTML and PDF.

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxstepscope


\section{Constraints}
\label{\detokenize{constraints:constraints}}\label{\detokenize{constraints::doc}}

\subsection{Technical Constraints}
\label{\detokenize{constraints:technical-constraints}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Budget} \textendash{} Zero additional cost. Uses existing infrastructure: laptop workstation, AWS EC2 instance (13.135.142.244), and GitHub repositories.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{API Dependencies} \textendash{} Requires OpenRouter API key, Telegram Bot Token (8107308256), and GitHub Personal Access Token. All credentials exist on the laptop and Command AWS.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Network} \textendash{} The laptop may have intermittent connectivity. The Command AWS has stable connectivity but shares a public IP. The AI AWS endpoint is not currently reachable via SSH.

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Operational Constraints}
\label{\detokenize{constraints:operational-constraints}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{No Auto\sphinxhyphen{}Merge} \textendash{} Pull requests must be reviewed and merged manually by the client. Never auto\sphinxhyphen{}merge.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Change Threshold} \textendash{} Repositories with more than 500 uncommitted files are explicitly skipped. Manual review is required before these changes are committed.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{YOLO Mode} \textendash{} The agent fallback runs in YOLO mode, meaning no approval prompts. It executes autonomously to resolve failures.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Cron Frequency} \textendash{} Every 5 minutes for change detection. No more frequent to avoid API rate limits.

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Documentation Constraints}
\label{\detokenize{constraints:documentation-constraints}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
All project documentation must use ReStructuredText (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.rst}}) format.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sphinx is the build system for HTML and PDF output.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Documents are placed under \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{datro/static/library/consortium\_projects/}}.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Build output includes HTML (English) and PDF.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{consortium\_projects/.treeview.json}} file must be updated.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstepscope


\section{Scope}
\label{\detokenize{scope:scope}}\label{\detokenize{scope::doc}}

\subsection{In Scope}
\label{\detokenize{scope:in-scope}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The following work is within the scope of the StarSync Network project:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cron\sphinxhyphen{}based sync script deployment on the laptop (16 repos)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cron\sphinxhyphen{}based sync script deployment on the Command AWS endpoint (2 repos)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Telegram bot integration for PR delivery notifications

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Hermes YOLO\sphinxhyphen{}mode agent fallback for sync failure recovery

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Automatic commit, push, and PR creation for repos under 500 changes

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Automatic pull of remote changes from GitHub on all endpoints

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Push of \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{static/ui}} (432 files) from Command AWS to GitHub (PR \#264)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Creation of Mandate, Brief, Plan, and Highlight Report documents

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sphinx build of HTML and PDF for all four documents

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pull request creation with preview links for client review

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Out of Scope}
\label{\detokenize{scope:out-of-scope}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The following work is explicitly excluded:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
AI AWS endpoint configuration (not reachable, deferred to future work)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Automated merging of pull requests (client must approve each PR)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compilation of non\sphinxhyphen{}English documents (English only for this version)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Resolution of the 28,000+ uncommitted changes in datro on the laptop

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Resolution of the 34,000+ uncommitted changes in datro on the Command AWS

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
GUI bug fixes or link generator repair (handled by InfraSync project)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
New feature development in any monitored repository

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstepscope


\section{Quality Standards}
\label{\detokenize{quality:quality-standards}}\label{\detokenize{quality::doc}}

\subsection{Script Quality}
\label{\detokenize{quality:script-quality}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Bash scripts use POSIX\sphinxhyphen{}compatible syntax with \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{set \sphinxhyphen{}uo pipefail}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Proper exit codes: 0 (success), 1 (failures), 2 (nothing to do)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Idempotent execution \textendash{} safe to run repeatedly

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Timestamped log files in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{/tmp/repo\sphinxhyphen{}sync/}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No credentials or secrets in log output

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Git Workflow Quality}
\label{\detokenize{quality:git-workflow-quality}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Branch naming: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{autosync/\{hostname\}/\{YYYYMMDD\sphinxhyphen{}HHMMSS\}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
PRs target the repository default branch (\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{gh\sphinxhyphen{}pages}} or \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{main}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Commit messages: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{autosync(\{hostname\}): YYYY\sphinxhyphen{}MM\sphinxhyphen{}DD (N files)}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pull operations use \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{git pull \sphinxhyphen{}\sphinxhyphen{}rebase}} for linear history

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Conflicts trigger agent fallback, never auto\sphinxhyphen{}resolved

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Documentation Quality}
\label{\detokenize{quality:documentation-quality}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
ReStructuredText format, Sphinx build verified

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Document IDs: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{MANDATE\sphinxhyphen{}STARNET\sphinxhyphen{}001}}, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{BRIEF\sphinxhyphen{}STARNET\sphinxhyphen{}001}}, etc.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
English HTML and PDF output verified

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{.treeview.json}} updated in each project directory

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
PR preview URL resolves to Cloudflare\sphinxhyphen{}served page

\end{itemize}
